facts.text: Jeffrey finds religion and becomes a better person.
Jeffrey is no longer burdened by guilt.
Jeffrey becomes close to his girlfriend Sarah once again.
Jeffrey and Sarah found one last CRT TV that Jeffrey didn’t sell online.
Jeffrey and Sarah deepen their commitment to each other while playing retro games on the CRT TV.
Mr. Smith realizes Jeffrey hasn’t been to work in ages.
Mr. Smith decides to track Jeffrey down and confront him.
Mr. Smith may decide to fire Jeffrey depending on how Jeffrey responds.
Thomas stumbles on Mr. Smith and Jeffrey.
Mr. Smith calls out Thomas’s biases.

events.text: Jeffrey finds religion and becomes a better person, no longer burdened by guilt, and becomes close to girlfriend Sarah again
